modelPlan.focus: evaluate the reliability of online sources, printed materials, and discussions with teachers and peers as sources of academic information for students.
keyArguments: Online sources can be unreliable due to lack of vetting and potential bias.
Printed books and articles are more reliable as they undergo rigorous peer review and editing.
Discussions with teachers and peers provide context and deeper understanding but may lack comprehensive information.
